svg.title: Village Armory proposed roof sections
svg.desc: Sections through the compact storehouse, supply yard, workshop, and porch show occupied roof courses, structural beams, lantern support, and reserved standing clearance. Slab and stair details require native validation.
svg.text: VILLAGE ARMORY / ROOF SECTIONS
Proposed occupied courses · floor blocks at Y=0 · open routes reserve air at Y=1..3
Compact / across the room
Z=6; horizontal axis X; lantern on the room beam
Roof slopes face each other; ridge details use slabs at Y=9.
The sorting area remains clear beneath the roof and beam.
Yard / through the supply corner
X=10; horizontal axis Z; front doors lie west of this cut
A
Two-row cross-aisle comes before the 3 × 3 supply area.
The canopy meets the main eave at Z=7, Y=5.
Workshop / through the working bay
Z=5; horizontal axis X; the exit is behind this cut at Z=6..7
The roof falls toward the court; the high side stays at Y=6.
Porch / below the main gable
X=7; horizontal axis Z; front beam spans to posts beside this cut

Courses show block locations, not exact stair/slab collision shapes. Native attachment, seams, lighting, and movement remain to be tested.
